Context: 10. Guidelines for issue of medicines to CGHS beneficiaries from CGHS Wellness Centres

- (k) Every Physician of CGHS Wellness Centre should prescribe drugs with generic name legibly and preferably in Capital Letters and he/she shall ensure that there is a rational prescription and use of drugs. - OM, dated 8-9-2017.
